title: Visa Isn't Your Lender. So Who Gets Paid?
description: The logo on your credit card isn't usually the company lending you money. Here's how issuing banks, merchant acquirers, and the Visa and Mastercard payment networks fit together—and why the merchant's fee isn't all network revenue. Simplified US four-party card model; actual arrangements vary. Narration is AI-generated with a local Kokoro voice. The Hidden Economics: The Stories Behind Money, Power and the World.
pinnedComment: Before watching, who did you think received most of the fee when you paid by card?
relatedLongForm: Follow one purchase from authorization through clearing and settlement, then explore interchange, network competition, regulation, and cross-border economics. Future concept only; no additional episode produced.
